office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the superior court and keeps its case files, dockets, juror records, and the court's orders and judgments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Kym Foster (Prefers Practical Democrat Party), clerk since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Grays Harbor County Clerk since 2019, re-elected unopposed in 2022; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Won the office in 2018 by 771 votes over the then-chief deputy clerk [S2]
Says her office brought electronic filing in-house and cut processing times [S2]
Kept summoning District Court juries in 2025 after a dispute, with District Court reimbursing the costs [S4][S5]
